raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Problem

`NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER` is on by default and registers the send/recv buffers of every graph-captured collective for the lifetime of the graph. Those buffers are graph-pool temporaries, and the pool hands the same addresses to other tensors, so a replay can find its registration pointing at memory that now belongs to something else.

Both existing guards key on a feature flag rather than on that aliasing:

- `enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all` additionally requires PD-decode, DP attention, `dp_size > 1` and `tp_size == dp_size`
- the pausable-pool check (dcf4e18) requires `enable_memory_saver` plus `SGLANG_MEMORY_SAVER_CUDA_GRAPH`, which is off by default

A plain multi-node TP deployment matches neither, so the registration stays on and the hang is reachable.

Features: more likely to appear under large batch size (> 128); not directly related to torch_memory_saver; currently does not appear in PREFILL stage but we still use any stage as gate to not regressing from the previous gate.

## Reproduction

Two TP16 engines spanning two H200 nodes each, decode batch 128, CUDA graph on, radix cache on, `max-running-requests 128`, a 501B MoE model. Load is 160 concurrent 4096-token generations per engine plus a pause/flush/continue cycle every 120s. `enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all` and `enable_memory_saver` are both false in every run below.

Every TP rank hits the 300s scheduler watchdog within the same second:

```
cuEventSynchronize
  cudaEventSynchronize
    torch/cuda/streams.py:254  synchronize
      batch_result_processor.py:927  process_batch_result_decode
        scheduler.py:4785  process_batch_result
          scheduler.py:1999  event_loop_overlap

[TP0..TP7] Scheduler watchdog timeout (watchdog_timeout=300.0, soft=False)
scheduler.cur_batch_for_debug.batch_size()=128
```

| run | peak decode batch | NCCL | `NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER` | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 66 | 2.29.7 | default (on) | clean for 1h |
| 2 | 128 | 2.29.7 | default (on) | hang at 19 min |
| 3 | 128 | 2.29.7 | default (on) | hang at 17 min |
| 4 | 128 | 2.29.7 | default (on), dcf4e18 applied | hang at 37 min |
| 5 | 128 | 2.29.7 | `0` | clean for 5h — 76k requests, 70M tokens, 148 cycles |
| 6 | 128 | **2.32.3** | default (on) | hang at 32 min |
| 7 | 128 | **2.32.3** | `0` | clean for 40 min |

Run 4 is why the dcf4e18 cherry-pick alone is not enough: it is in the tree, neither of its conditions matches, so the variable is never set and the hang is unchanged.

Runs 6 and 7 rule out a stale NCCL as the cause. 2.32.3 carries the fix for NVIDIA/nccl#2389, which has a similar signature, and the hang still reproduces with the registration on and still disappears with it off.

Two further conditions were tested and are *not* required: `NCCL_PXN_DISABLE=1` still hangs (7 min), and all of the above runs have the TP LM-head all-to-all and the memory saver off. Disabling GDR (`NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL=0`) does hold for 50 min with the registration on, which points at the network registration path, but that is not something this layer can detect at argument-resolution time.

## Cost

Same engine, same tree, same load, 10 minutes each:

| registration | requests | tokens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| on | 1,765 | 2,060,061 |
| off | 1,781 | 2,066,577 |

No measurable throughput difference. Single run per configuration, not repeated for variance. Worth noting that the non-registered path is the one every deployment used before the default flipped, so it is not a new or lightly-exercised code path.

## Change

One condition replaces both: `max(tp_size, ep_size, dp_size) > 1` with any graph phase still enabled means a capture can hold a collective, which is exactly when a registration can outlive the pool's claim on the address. It errs toward disabling — later passes can still narrow `cuda_graph_config`, and a false positive costs nothing measurable.

Keying on any phase rather than decode alone keeps the pausable-pool case that dcf4e18 added: with the decode capture off and the memory saver on, a prefill capture still lands in that pool.

The test that asserted the variable stays unset without the TP LM-head all-to-all encoded the old contract and now asserts the new one. Added alongside it: the pausable pool in isolation, a prefill-only capture, a single rank, and a fully disabled graph.

Draft while the deployment-shape coverage gets a second opinion — happy to narrow the condition if there is a configuration where the registration is known to be safe and worth keeping. The root cause is still open: these runs establish which conditions reproduce it and which do not, not the mechanism inside NCCL.

@@ -345,26 +345,35 @@ def handle_data_parallelism(server_args: Any):
 
     run_post_process_pass(server_args, _tp_lm_head_all_to_all_default)
     run_post_process_pass(server_args, _dp_lm_head_validation)
-    if resolving_view(server_args).enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all:
+    if _graph_may_capture_collectives(server_args):
         _disable_nccl_graph_buffer_registration(
-            "the graph-captured TP LM-head all-to-all can deadlock with "
-            "registered buffers"
-        )
-    if _graph_pool_is_pausable(server_args):
-        _disable_nccl_graph_buffer_registration(
-            "graph replay can hang once torch_memory_saver resume remaps the "
-            "graph pool, leaving the capture-time registrations on released pages"
+            "graph-captured collectives run on graph-pool temporaries whose "
+            "addresses the pool also hands to other tensors"
         )
 
 
-def _graph_pool_is_pausable(server_args: Any) -> bool:
-    """Whether CUDA graphs are captured into torch_memory_saver memory, which
-    release/resume of the `cuda_graph` tag remaps to new physical pages at the
-    same virtual addresses."""
-    return bool(
-        resolving_view(server_args).enable_memory_saver
-        and envs.SGLANG_MEMORY_SAVER_CUDA_GRAPH.get()
-    )
+def _graph_may_capture_collectives(server_args: Any) -> bool:
+    """Whether any captured CUDA graph can hold a cross-rank collective.
+
+    Capture binds a collective's send/recv buffers to graph-pool temporaries,
+    and the pool hands those same addresses to other tensors. Which collective
+    got captured, which phase captured it, and whether the pool is later
+    remapped by torch_memory_saver only change how that aliasing is reached -
+    not whether it exists - so the guard tracks the hazard rather than the
+    feature flags that expose it. A decode-only check would miss a prefill
+    capture into a pausable pool, which the pool guard used to cover.
+
+    Errs toward True. Later passes can still narrow cuda_graph_config, and
+    turning the registration off has no measured throughput cost, so a false
+    positive is cheaper than a missed deployment shape.
+    """
+    view = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if max(view.tp_size, view.ep_size, view.dp_size) <= 1:
+        return False
+    config = getattr(view, "cuda_graph_config", None)
+    if config is None:
+        return True
+    return any(config[phase].backend != Backend.DISABLED for phase in Phase.ALL)
 
 
 def _disable_nccl_graph_buffer_registration(reason: str) -> None:

@@ -3995,23 +3995,24 @@ def test_an_explicit_value_equal_to_the_generic_one_still_reads_as_set(self):
 
 
 class TestTpLmHeadAllToAllNcclGraphRegister(unittest.TestCase):
-    """The graph-captured TP LM-head all-to-all must not run with NCCL's
-    graph buffer registration: registered graph-pool temporaries deadlock the
-    exchange under DP-rank ramps."""
+    """A decode graph that can capture a collective must not run with NCCL's
+    graph buffer registration: the registered graph-pool temporaries alias
+    tensors the pool hands out later, and replay then deadlocks."""
 
     def _resolve(self, **kwargs):
         # The handler reads the DP-adjusted prefill knobs the pipeline would
         # have settled by then; the dummy-model pipeline itself returns early.
-        server_args = ServerArgs(

             tp_size=2,
             chunked_prefill_size=8192,
             cuda_graph_config=CudaGraphConfig(
                 prefill=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED)
             ),
-            **kwargs,
         )
+        fields.update(kwargs)
+        server_args = ServerArgs(**fields)
         parallel_hook.handle_data_parallelism(server_args)
         return server_args
 
@@ -4031,9 +4032,9 @@ def test_explicit_nccl_graph_register_is_kept(self):

             self.assertIn("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER=1", "\n".join(logs.output))

-        # Unified serving keeps the all-to-all off by default, and a decode

+    def test_without_all_to_all_registration_still_defaults_off(self):
+        # The hazard is the graph-captured collective, not the feature that
+        # happens to issue it, so the default holds with the all-to-all off.
         for kwargs in (
             {},
             {"disaggregation_mode": "decode", "enable_dp_lm_head": True},
@@ -4044,7 +4045,52 @@ def test_without_all_to_all_env_is_untouched(self):

                     resolution_result(server_args, "enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all")
                 )
-                self.assertNotIn("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", os.environ)
+                self.assertEqual(os.environ.get("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER"), "0")
+
+    def test_pausable_graph_pool_defaults_off(self):
+        # Isolates the torch_memory_saver trigger: the all-to-all stays off, so
+        # only the remapped graph pool can account for the default.
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
+            os.environ.pop("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", None)
+            server_args = self._resolve(enable_memory_saver=True)
+            self.assertFalse(
+                resolution_result(server_args, "enable_tp_lm_head_all_to_all")
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ.get("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER"), "0")
+
+    def test_prefill_only_capture_defaults_off(self):
+        # Decode capture off, prefill still capturing into the same pausable
+        # pool: the collective is in a graph either way, so the registration has
+        # to go regardless of which phase holds it.
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
+            os.environ.pop("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", None)
+            self._resolve(
+                enable_memory_saver=True,
+                cuda_graph_config=CudaGraphConfig(
+                    decode=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED),
+                    prefill=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.FULL),
+                ),
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(os.environ.get("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER"), "0")
+
+    def test_single_rank_env_is_untouched(self):
+        # One rank issues no collective, so a capture registers nothing.
+        with patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=False):
+            os.environ.pop("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", None)
+            self._resolve(attn_dp_size=1, tp_size=1)
+            self.assertNotIn("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", os.environ)

+                    decode=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED),
+                    prefill=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED),
+                )
+            )
+            self.assertNotIn("NCCL_GRAPH_REGISTER", os.environ)
